title: Example Foundry Flex Park appraisal December 31, 2025
summary: Example Foundry Flex Park · As of December 31, 2025

evidence.quote: This appraisal of Example Foundry Flex Park, 915 Example Foundry Way, Salt Lake City, UT, was prepared by Example Valuation Advisors.
The effective date of value is December 31, 2025.
The date of this report is January 22, 2026.
The interest appraised is the leased fee interest.
The market value of the property, as is, is $48,700,000.
The income capitalization and sales comparison approaches were used for the 320,000 square feet in 78 units.
